description: Parking Transactions is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the number, type and date of car parking transactions located in Ballarat. The information was collected as the transactions occurred. The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the number of parking transactions occurring in Ballarat's car parking zones. The dataset is typically updated monthly on manual schedule. Coverage: City of Ballarat. The portal files it under the publisher City of Ballarat. Its tags are car-parking, parking, public-transport, smarter-parking. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, XLS. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
